name: perse-remote-dev-workspace
description: Build workspace for perse-remote-dev — an out-of-tree DSH remote-development plugin of Persevere with DSH. The installable package lives in packages/perse-remote-dev.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run codegen && npm run bundle && npm run bundle:client
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack --workspace perse-remote-dev
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/verify-generated.mjs && node scripts/verify-client-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-host-surface.mjs
